description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WPF application, with MVVM binding, Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: Protected mail-merge fields remain unchanged when a paste would replace only part of a token, for native and managed paste. Ordinary text and whole-field replacements undo in one step. Text-format clipboard reads retry brief contention. No public API changes.
title: SpiceLogic WPF HTML Editor Control
